title: Making Glass Retrievable: cross-media infrastructures of microscope preparations
research_problem: The project now contains several cases in which a slide survives but its historical usefulness depends on a second medium: an issue number, catalogue, key, label, cabinet coordinate, station number, card, ledger, plate caption or archive call number. The shared problem is therefore not simply circulation or preservation, but how a fragile microscopic object remains findable in relation to the evidence that made it intelligible.
first_order_claim: Microscope slides became durable knowledge objects when institutions and makers built cross-media retrieval systems around them. The glass carries only part of the address. Paper, cabinets, catalogues, labels and later databases preserve or rewrite the rest. A slide can remain physically intact while losing its earlier epistemic identity if the crosswalk disappears.

cases.retrieval_operation: find preparation from issue and issue from preparation
cases.failure_mode: book enters Library, preparations enter Cabinet; later catalogue can cease preserving the common publication address
cases.distinctive_point: physical separation was designed; referential separation is the historical loss

cases.glass_address: Type Slide number/category + internal specimen grid
cases.retrieval_operation: locate a named species within a compressed comparative field
cases.failure_mode: slide survives but key/list/product identity is detached; posthumous archive dispersal separates tools, notes, samples and cabinets
cases.distinctive_point: classification itself becomes a spatial retrieval interface

cases.retrieval_operation: move from a preparation back to where/how material was collected and forward to later taxonomic/analytical interpretation
cases.failure_mode: physical separation of slide cabinet from sediment; registration/subnumber changes; collecting label can be over-read as complete material description
cases.distinctive_point: modern CT can revise the interpretation of the historical address without destroying it

cases.glass_address: catalogue offering number / Station label / possible preparator label
cases.retrieval_operation: match a distributed preparation to a standardized institutional offering and transaction
cases.failure_mode: maker, Station and later business labels can be conflated; surviving object number may not be original catalogue number
cases.distinctive_point: a catalogue address can survive only partially on the physical slide

cases.retrieval_operation: use printed plate captions to date/identify the optics that made a preparation visually legible
cases.failure_mode: shared departmental custody tempts false one-to-one assignment of an apparatus to a slide
cases.distinctive_point: publication paratext can be an instrument-use register

cases.retrieval_operation: preserve old laboratory address while adding current museum/database address
cases.failure_mode: recataloguing would sever history if old identifiers/cards were discarded
cases.distinctive_point: positive control: modern cataloguing can preserve address succession rather than replace it

cases.retrieval_operation: make re-addressing itself visible by retaining obsolete and current coordinates together
cases.failure_mode: flattening multiple historical identifiers into one accession would erase the administrative history
cases.distinctive_point: the catalogue can document address change as evidence

cases.retrieval_operation: recover manufacture, retail and private ownership as separate transactions
cases.failure_mode: single creator field collapses maker, seller and collector
cases.distinctive_point: label accumulation is transaction history, not metadata noise

writing_payoff.cole_article: Keep retrievability implicit and concrete: issue numbers and cabinet numbers matter because they bind glass to print. Do not turn the article into a general theory of metadata.
writing_payoff.elcock_article_or_section: Use the Type Slide as an interface: species classification becomes a printed/spatial finding system on the object itself.
writing_payoff.global_slides_project: Use retrievability as the common comparative variable across unlike institutions rather than claiming a single global slide culture.
writing_payoff.database: Store address succession and crosswalk evidence as derived data. Never normalize old numbers away.

strongest_sentence: The historical survival of a microscope slide is not only the survival of glass. It is the survival, translation, or reconstruction of an address between glass and other records.
